title: Challenge Yourself With FightCamp Solo Milestone Challenges
summary: Step up your workout game and challenge yourself to reach your fitness goals sooner with the Solo Challenges feature exclusively on the FightCamp App.
body_markdown:
## What’s New on the FightCamp App


Hey FightCamp Fam, we have something new for you, and just in time to get a head start on those fitness resolutions! Starting December 1st, 2022 on the[FightCamp App](https://joinfightcamp.com/?utm_source=organicBlog&utm_content=homepage) , we are adding a Challenges feature with a gamified twist for your workouts.


Challenge yourself each month with a solo challenge. Earn points for your output and reach milestones to receive exclusive challenge badges.


## How Do the Solo Challenges Work


-


Each month a new challenge will be released on the FightCamp App.


-


See Challenge rules and progress under the Challenges tab on the app.


-


Every challenge will have a timeframe for you to gain points through your activity in FightCamp workouts.


-


Challenge points go towards earning a monthly Challenge badge.


-


Keep track of your challenge progress in the Progress Report to see how close you are to earning a challenge badge.


-


At the end of completing a challenge, if you earned enough points based on your activity in your workouts, you can qualify for one of the following badge levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum.


## When Will the First Solo Challenge Start


### December Solo Challenge


December Solo Challenge Start & End Dates:


-


Start Date: December 1, 2022 0:00am UTC


-


End Date: December 31, 2022 11:59pm UTC


December Solo Challenge Rules:


-


Earn 1 point per 1 punch in a FightCamp workout on the app


December Solo Challenge Milestone Badges:


-


Bronze - 2,300 Challenge Points (Punches)


-


Silver - 4,500 Challenge Points (Punches)


-


Gold - 9,000 Challenge Points (Punches)


-


Platinum - 13,000 Challenge Points (Punches)


*Be sure to download the latest iOS version of FightCamp (5.0.0) to get the new Challenges feature.


## Train Like a Fighter


End 2022 and start 2023 strong with your first solo challenge on the FightCamp App!


Take your workouts to the next level and train like a fighter with the at-home connected fitness solution used by world champion boxers Mike Tyson and Floyd Mayweather. Work out on your schedule, with premium boxing equipment and hundreds of on-demand strength, conditioning, kickboxing, boxing, core, and recovery classes led by real fighters.


As Mike Tyson said - “[FightCamp](https://joinfightcamp.com/shop/?utm_source=organicBlog&utm_medium=&utm_content=packages) is the next level of training!”
